content.purposeText: This application is designed for educational and ethical self-research purposes only. It helps you discover your own public profiles across various websites.
content.usageText:
• Only search for your own usernames and email addresses
• Do not use this tool to search for other people's information
• Respect website terms of service and robots.txt files
• Use responsibly and ethically
content.privacyText:
• All searches are performed locally on your device
• No personal data is sent to external servers
• Search results are stored locally and can be cleared at any time
• We do not collect or store your search queries
content.limitationsText:
• Results may not be 100% accurate
• Some websites may block automated requests
• Search results depend on website availability
• This tool is for informational purposes only
content.disclaimerText: This application is provided 'as is' without warranty. Users are responsible for complying with applicable laws and website terms of service. The developers are not liable for any misuse of this tool.

about.title: About
about.description: A cross-platform desktop application for discovering public profiles across hundreds of websites.
about.longDescription: NameSeeker is a powerful cross-platform desktop application that searches for usernames and emails across hundreds of websites, helping you quickly discover your digital footprint. Based on WhatsMyName project data, supports exporting search results to PDF, CSV, JSON and other formats.
about.author: Author

features.title: Key Features
features.search: Username and email search across 600+ websites
features.export: Export results in multiple formats (CSV, JSON, PDF, TXT)
features.privacy: Local processing - no data sent to external servers
features.searching: Search usernames and emails across hundreds of websites

technology.title: Technology Stack
technology.communication: Tauri event system for real-time updates

dataSource.title: Data Source
dataSource.description: This application is based on data from the WhatsMyName project, which maintains search rules for 600+ websites. Thanks to the WebBreacher team for their open source contributions.

acknowledgments.title: Special Thanks
acknowledgments.description: Thanks to the Blackbird project for inspiration and reference. Blackbird is a powerful OSINT tool with integrated AI analysis capabilities.

usageNotice.title: Usage Notice
usageNotice.description: This tool is for educational and legal self-research purposes only. Please comply with relevant laws and regulations, use this tool responsibly. Do not use for illegal purposes or infringe on others' privacy.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.step1: Enter a username or email address in the search field
gettingStarted.step2: Select the search type (Username or Email)
gettingStarted.step3: Click 'Search' to start the search process
gettingStarted.step4: View results in real-time as they appear
gettingStarted.step5: Export results in your preferred format

features.title: Features Guide
features.searchText: Search across 600+ websites for usernames and email addresses
features.resultsText: View, filter, and sort search results by various criteria
features.exportText: Export results to CSV, JSON, PDF, or plain text formats
features.historyText: Access your recent searches and save time on repeated queries

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.slowSearchText: Try reducing the number of concurrent requests in settings
troubleshooting.noResultsText: Check if the username/email exists and try different variations
troubleshooting.errorsText: Some websites may be temporarily unavailable or blocking requests
